archiveTitle: Morning Brief | HoYoverse unveils new title at Gamescom Opening Night Live

entries.headline: HoYoverse announces realistic fantasy co-op action title Nodusfall
entries.summary: HoYoverse has revealed its first multiplayer co-op action game built with Unreal Engine 5. Players take on the role of 'Weavers' in a realistic dark fantasy world where divine authority has collapsed, battling mythological creatures. Platforms and release date have not been announced.
entries.verification: Official trailer checked; developer, co-op action positioning, and unannounced platforms/date cross-verified with Game*Spark and Inside.
entries.timeNote: Official livestream recorded at 18:10 UTC, corresponding to 02:10 Beijing time.

mediaAlts.alt: Nodusfall official trailer still, used as the news image

entries.headline: Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six Tactics revealed: turn-based solo tactics with 15 operators
entries.summary: Ubisoft has announced a turn-based solo tactical title where players deploy 15 operators across more than 45 locations, planning actions based on terrain, enemy intel, and skill combinations. Expected to launch on PS5, Xbox Series, and PC in 2027.
entries.verification: Ubisoft press release checked; platforms, year, operator and location counts cross-verified with Gematsu.
entries.timeNote: Gematsu timestamped August 25, 14:11 EDT, corresponding to August 26, 02:11 Beijing time.

mediaAlts.alt: Rainbow Six Tactics official trailer still, used as the news image

entries.headline: Gears of War: E-Day gets new story trailer, expands dark campaign enemy roster
entries.summary: Xbox and The Coalition have released a new story trailer showcasing new creatures and antagonists from the Emergence Day campaign. The October 6 release date was not newly announced, so only the new material increment is recorded.
entries.verification: Xbox official trailer and Gematsu checked; only new story material from this window is covered, without repeating the old release date.
entries.timeNote: Gematsu timestamped August 25, 14:14 EDT, corresponding to August 26, 02:14 Beijing time.

mediaAlts.alt: Gears of War: E-Day official trailer still, used as the news image

entries.headline: SILENT HILL: TOWNFALL reveals English voice cast
entries.summary: Konami and Screen Burn have revealed that Jovan Adepo, Kezia Burrows, and Terry O'Quinn will voice Simon, Zoe, and Richard respectively. The September 24 release schedule remains unchanged.
entries.verification: Official trailer and Gematsu checked; names, roles, and the established date are stated separately.
entries.timeNote: Gematsu timestamped August 25, 14:19 EDT, corresponding to August 26, 02:19 Beijing time.

mediaAlts.alt: SILENT HILL: TOWNFALL official trailer still, used as the news image

entries.headline: NetEase's ANANTA launches globally on January 15, 2027
entries.summary: NetEase Games and Naked Rain have announced that the free-to-play open-world urban RPG will launch on PS5, PC, iOS, and Android. A new trailer showcases cities inspired by Shanghai, Hangzhou, and Tokyo, along with vehicles, social influence, and multi-character switching.
entries.verification: Official trailer checked; date, platforms, free-to-play positioning, and developer cross-verified with Gematsu.
entries.timeNote: Official livestream recorded at 18:23 UTC, corresponding to 02:23 Beijing time; Gematsu timestamped 14:18 EDT.

mediaAlts.alt: ANANTA official trailer still, used as the news image

entries.headline: KRAFTON announces multiplayer FPS PUBG: DED.NET
entries.summary: The new title combines short-match multiplayer FPS with roguelite in-run progression. Players lose their current loadout after each round and rebuild. Planned for PS5, Xbox Series, and PC; no release date announced.
entries.verification: Official website announcement checked; gameplay, platforms, and undated status cross-verified with Gematsu.
entries.timeNote: Gematsu timestamped August 25, 14:34 EDT, corresponding to August 26, 02:34 Beijing time.

mediaAlts.alt: PUBG: DED.NET official trailer still, used as the news image

entries.headline: Tides of Annihilation unveils 'Beneath the Veil' story trailer
entries.summary: Chengdu-based Eclipse Glow Games showcases modern London and the Avalon catastrophe, Knight of the Round Table Lancelot, and the first official footage featuring Angela Sant'Albano as the new English voice of the protagonist. A first global playable demo is available on-site.
entries.verification: Official trailer checked; voice cast, platforms, and first global demo cross-confirmed with Gematsu and PlayStation Universe.
entries.timeNote: Official livestream recorded at 18:40 UTC, corresponding to 02:40 Beijing time.

mediaAlts.alt: Tides of Annihilation official trailer still, used as the news image

entries.headline: EXODUS dated for April 7, 2027
entries.summary: Archetype Entertainment has announced that the sci-fi action RPG will launch on PS5, Xbox Series, and PC on April 7, 2027.
entries.verification: Official release date trailer and Gematsu checked for platform and date information.
entries.timeNote: Gematsu timestamped August 25, 14:44 EDT, corresponding to August 26, 02:44 Beijing time.

mediaAlts.alt: EXODUS official trailer still, used as the news image

entries.headline: Showa American Story gets Gamescom gameplay trailer
entries.summary: Wuhan-based NEKCOM Games and 2P Games showcase Chigusa Kocho's melee, shooting, executions, exploration, and life sim minigames in a 'Japanized America' post-apocalyptic setting. Still planned for PS5 and PC; no specific date announced.
entries.verification: Official trailer checked; developer, publisher, platforms, and date boundaries cross-verified with Gematsu.
entries.timeNote: Official livestream recorded at 19:29 UTC, corresponding to 03:29 Beijing time.

mediaAlts.alt: Showa American Story official trailer still, used as the news image

entries.headline: Heroes of Might and Magic III Remake announced, fully remaking base game and two expansions
entries.summary: Unfrozen has announced a remake covering the original base game and two expansions, featuring 9 factions and supporting up to 8 players in online or hotseat modes. Planned for PS5, Xbox Series, and PC; date undecided.
entries.verification: Official trailer and Gematsu checked; content scope, faction count, multiplayer modes, platforms, and undated status confirmed.
entries.timeNote: Gematsu timestamped August 25, 15:32 EDT, corresponding to August 26, 03:32 Beijing time.

mediaAlts.alt: Heroes of Might and Magic III Remake official trailer still, used as the news image

entries.headline: Turok: Origins delayed from fall 2026 to spring 2027
entries.summary: Saber Interactive has shifted the release window to spring 2027. Platforms remain PS5, Xbox Series, Switch 2, and PC.
entries.verification: Official trailer checked; old window, new window, and platforms cross-verified with Gematsu. No specific date inferred.
entries.timeNote: Official livestream recorded at 19:37 UTC, corresponding to 03:37 Beijing time.

mediaAlts.alt: Turok: Origins official trailer still, used as the news image

entries.headline: City builder LEGO Skylines announced
entries.summary: A new title combining the Cities: Skylines concept with LEGO bricks will launch on PS5, Xbox Series, Switch 2, and PC. No release date has been announced.
entries.verification: Official trailer and Gematsu checked; only project, platforms, and undated status confirmed.
entries.timeNote: Gematsu timestamped August 25, 15:39 EDT, corresponding to August 26, 03:39 Beijing time.

mediaAlts.alt: LEGO Skylines official trailer still, used as the news image

entries.headline: Path of Exile 2 launches 1.0 on December 11
entries.summary: Grinding Gear Games has announced a full release date of December 11, 2026, marking the transition from early access to 1.0. Unannounced version content is not expanded upon.
entries.verification: Official date trailer checked; date and 1.0 milestone confirmed item-by-item with PC Gamer.
entries.timeNote: Official livestream recorded at 19:45 UTC, corresponding to 03:45 Beijing time.

mediaAlts.alt: Path of Exile 2 official trailer still, used as the news image

entries.headline: Crimson Desert gets free Enhanced upgrade with Japanese voice acting and main story improvements
entries.summary: Pearl Abyss has announced and launched a free update adding new story and cutscenes, additional voice options including Japanese, and main story improvements. A 20% discount is active across platforms.
entries.verification: Official trailer entry checked; update launch, voice options, main story improvements, and discount cross-verified with Game*Spark.
entries.timeNote: Game*Spark published at 03:52 Beijing time; official announcement and update launch occurred during the same Opening Night Live window.

mediaAlts.alt: Crimson Desert official trailer still, used as the news image

entries.headline: Mega Man: Dual Override gets first trailer and new boss 'Twinkle Girl'
entries.summary: Capcom showcases the 'Override' mechanic that powers up Mega Man, customizable chips for adjusting performance, and a new boss. The game is planned for 2027 on current and previous-gen consoles, Switch/2, and PC.
entries.verification: Official video entry and Game*Spark checked; new mechanics, characters, platforms, and 2027 window confirmed.
entries.timeNote: Game*Spark published on-site coverage at 04:00 Beijing time.

mediaAlts.alt: Mega Man: Dual Override official trailer still, used as the news image

entries.headline: Roco Kingdom announces global version and October 27 closed beta
entries.summary: Tencent's MoreFun Studios has announced a global version covering PS5, Xbox Series, PC, iOS, and Android. The closed beta begins October 27 on PC and mobile, with registration now open. The full release date has not been announced.
entries.verification: Official recruitment page and Steam product page checked; platforms, beta date, and pending full release date cross-confirmed with Gematsu.
entries.timeNote: Official livestream recorded at 20:01 UTC, corresponding to 04:01 Beijing time.

mediaAlts.alt: Roco Kingdom official trailer still, used as the news image

entries.headline: FINAL FANTASY VII REVELATION new trailer shows WEAPON and spring 2027 window
entries.summary: Square Enix's 'Planet Crisis' trailer shows Cloud and company facing WEAPON, the Typhon summon, and new footage of parachutes, grappling hooks, chocobos, and job costumes. The third installment remains planned for spring 2027.
entries.verification: Official trailer checked; WEAPON, Typhon, and spring window cross-verified with Gematsu. Chinese subtitle only marks the common localized name.
entries.timeNote: Official livestream recorded at 20:06 UTC, corresponding to 04:06 Beijing time; Gematsu article published slightly earlier.

mediaAlts.alt: FINAL FANTASY VII REVELATION official trailer still, used as the news image

entries.headline: The Witcher 3 remaster launches September 29, 'Songs of the Past' reveals new region
entries.summary: The remaster launches on PS5, Xbox Series, Switch 2, PC, and Battle.net. Eligible current-gen and PC owners of the original get a free upgrade, and original owners also receive the two old expansions for free. The new expansion reveals the Letten region for the first time, still slated for 2027.
entries.verification: CDPR press release checked; date, platforms, free upgrade, Battle.net, and Letten confirmed. The Verge cross-confirmed.
entries.timeNote: Official livestream announced between 20:13–20:15 UTC, corresponding to 04:13–04:15 Beijing time.

mediaAlts.alt: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt remaster official press key art

entries.headline: Level Infinite and Behaviour announce three-player co-op PvE shooter Exterminauts
entries.summary: The new title focuses on three-player co-op PvE third-person shooting, with squads battling alien threats. Planned for PS5, Xbox Series, and PC; no specific date announced.
entries.verification: Official trailer entry and Game*Spark checked; listed separately due to Tencent subsidiary Level Infinite, prioritized as a Chinese entity.
entries.timeNote: Game*Spark published at 05:38 Beijing time, updated at 06:16.

mediaAlts.alt: Exterminauts official trailer still, used as the news image

entries.headline: Paradox officially announces post-apocalyptic grand strategy Afterworld
entries.summary: Paradox and Iceflake Studios have officially unveiled the PC title: players manage settlements, resources, and populations in a procedurally generated post-apocalyptic North America, with cooperative or competitive multiplayer. Release date undecided.
entries.verification: Paradox official page and 4Gamer report checked; previous leak status superseded by the official announcement.
entries.timeNote: 4Gamer published at 05:45 Beijing time; official reveal occurred in the earlier livestream window, media time not presented as official precise time.

mediaAlts.alt: Afterworld official trailer still, used as the news image

entries.headline: Monster Hunter Outlanders reveals first original Elder Dragon-level monster
entries.summary: TiMi Studio Group and Capcom have showcased the first original Elder Dragon-level monster in new material. The project targets iOS and Android; no full release date announced.
entries.verification: Official website checked; developer, platforms, and new monster showcase cross-verified with Game*Spark. Chinese name marked with common localized title.
